rounds.lie: “Tengo que repasar” means “I want to rest”.
rounds.why: “Repasar” = to revise and “tengo que” = I have to. “I want to rest” would be “quiero descansar”.
rounds.truth: “Tengo que repasar” means “I have to revise”.
truths: “Quiero ser enfermero” means “I want to be a nurse”.
“Hago mis deberes” means “I do my homework”.

rounds.lie: “Mi hermana es aburrida” means “My sister is bored”.
rounds.truth: “Mi hermana es aburrida” means “My sister is boring”.
truths: “Es muy trabajador” means “He is very hard-working”.

rounds.lie: “No se permite usar el móvil en clase” means “you may use your phone in class”.
rounds.why: “No se permite” means “it is not allowed”, so phones are forbidden, not permitted.
rounds.truth: “No se permite usar el móvil en clase” means “you may not use your phone in class”.

rounds.lie: “Las matemáticas me resultan difíciles” means “I find maths easy”.
rounds.why: “Difíciles” means “difficult”, so it means “I find maths difficult”; “easy” would be “fáciles”.
rounds.truth: “Las matemáticas me resultan difíciles” means “I find maths difficult”.

rounds.lie: “Estoy en paro” means “I am on a break”.
rounds.why: “Estar en paro” means “to be unemployed”. “On a break” would be “en un descanso”.
truths: “Trabajo a tiempo parcial” means “I work part-time”.

rounds.lie: “Trabajo a tiempo parcial” means “I work full-time”.
rounds.why: “A tiempo parcial” means “part-time”; full-time is “a tiempo completo”.
rounds.truth: “Trabajo a tiempo parcial” means “I work part-time”.

truths: “Me gusta tocar la guitarra” means “I like playing the guitar”.
“Suelo quedar con mis amigos” means “I usually meet up with my friends”.
